<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def nodes():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],(r0,c0,r1,c1)))
    return out
before=nodes()
res=action(['SPACE'],intent='explore')

def key(x): return (x[0],x[2])
bs={key(x):x[1] for x in before}; as_={key(x):x[1] for x in after}
print("REMOVED:", [ (k,bs[k]) for k in bs if k not in as_])
print("ADDED:", [ (k,as_[k]) for k in as_ if k not in bs])
print("CHANGED:", [ (k,bs[k],as_[k]) for k in bs if k in as_ and bs[k]!=as_[k]])
